concerns.text: FR-001 (and US-1) require a minimum of **20 observations per species** ("filter for datasets with ... at least 20 observations per species"). FR-024 later mandates a **minimum of 30 observations per species** for the a priori power analysis. This creates a direct contradiction about the required sample size per species.
FR-024’s power‑analysis requirement (≥30 observations per species) conflicts with the earlier filtering rule (≥20 observations per species) without any stated reconciliation or conditional logic.
